## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria: skill clears and engage remind are documented and tested, and dashboard dismiss works through the real Textual entry point for human gates only.

## Approach

1. Run the skill-contract consistency suite and the skill doc tests added for clear/remind.
2. Run the dashboard dismiss pilot tests (success, refuse, CLI failure) through the app.
3. Confirm acceptances for skill-needs-clear and dashboard-dismiss still match the exit criteria.
